$comment: Canonical cross-repository integration lock for the Frontera runtime, frozen by P0-PKG-02. It is the handoff PMFreak consumes next. It records identities and authorizes nothing: no registry publication, no tag, no GitHub Release, no merge. Validate the Protocol half with `node scripts/protocol/check-compatibility-lock.mjs`; reproduce the Frontera half with `npm run check:clean-room-consumer`.

protocol.verificationMethod: Repacked from the pinned source commit with scripts/protocol/build-protocol-tarball.mjs in a clean worktree; name, version, private status, SHA-256, SHA-512, size, file count and exports fingerprint all recomputed locally and matched.
protocol.consumedAs: peerDependency for consumers; vendored, checksummed tarball for this repository's own validation

packageIdentityConclusion.question: Is @aoc-enterprise/runtime the canonical Frontera package PMFreak should consume?
evidence: It is the root package of Soberania-Protocol/Soberania-Enterprise (package.json name = @aoc-enterprise/runtime, version 1.0.0).
It is the only package in this repository with a public exports map intended for external consumption (10 declared export keys) and a files allowlist restricting the artifact to dist.

It is the package the repository's own release machinery targets: validate-publishability.mjs packs it and installs it into an external-consumer fixture; check-runtime-release-integrity.mjs asserts its export targets exist; release/RELEASE_MANIFEST.json names it.
It is the identifier PMFreak already declares (as file:src/aoc/enterprise), per the Protocol repository's frozen cross-repository integration contract.
packageIdentityConclusion.relationshipToAocEnterprise: @aoc/enterprise is a DIFFERENT, unrelated package: a private:true Assurance workspace living at enterprise/ inside the Soberania_Protocol repository, version 0.1.0, with its own ./assurance/* export map. It is not an alias of @aoc-enterprise/runtime, is not built by this repository, and is not the PMFreak handoff. Protocol's own integration-contract.json recorded this as unresolved; this increment resolves it: @aoc-enterprise/runtime is produced by Soberania-Protocol/Soberania-Enterprise, and @aoc/enterprise is a Protocol-internal workspace with a coincidentally similar name.

blockingFinding.summary: The packaged artifact is not self-contained. Its shipped dist requires 13 @aoc-enterprise/* workspace packages at runtime that are absent from `dependencies`; all are private:true and depend on each other through file:../<sibling> specifiers that resolve only inside this monorepo.
blockingFinding.consequenceForPmfreak: PMFreak may consume the 7 exports above from the frozen artifact today. The 3 blocked exports cannot be consumed from a packaged install by any external repository until an artifact-shape decision is made and executed.
blockingFinding.decisionRequired: Choose how the 13 private workspace packages reach an external consumer: (a) bundledDependencies in @aoc-enterprise/runtime, (b) inline them into dist at build time, (c) publish them as real packages and replace the file:../ specifiers with versions, or (d) narrow the public export surface so kernel/enterprise/kernel-host are not offered externally. Each changes the artifact or the public API and therefore needs its own approved increment.

pmfreakObligations: PMFreak must consume the exact frozen Frontera artifact identified above, by SHA-256.
PMFreak must stop using file:src/aoc/protocol and install the pinned @aoc/protocol candidate instead.
PMFreak must not copy Frontera source.
PMFreak must not reinterpret Protocol contracts through local copies.
PMFreak must import only through declared export keys of each package.
PMFreak must record repository, commit, version and SHA-256 of every installed artifact in its own consumer lock file.
PMFreak must run a blocking CI job that reinstalls the pinned artifacts and re-runs its consumer battery.
PMFreak must not depend on the 3 blocked exports until the blocking finding above is closed.
explicitNonClaims: Three-repository integration has NOT passed and is not claimed.
PMFreak was not modified in this increment.
Soberania Protocol was not modified in this increment.
No package was published to any registry.
